name: OpenCode

requirements.hint: Bun: https://bun.sh (the exact version a release pins is provisioned automatically)

dev:
R={root}; E="$R/node_modules/.openmods-dev.ts"; printf 'Object.assign(globalThis, { OPENCODE_VERSION: "%s", OPENCODE_CHANNEL: "openmods-dev" })
await import("../packages/cli/node_modules/@opentui/solid/scripts/preload.js")
await import("../packages/cli/src/index.ts")
' '{version}' > "$E.$$" && mv -f "$E.$$" "$E" || { echo "openmods dev: could not write $E" >&2; exit 1; }; S=; case "$1" in "") S=1 ;; --version|-v|--help|-h) ;; -*) S=1 ;; .|..|*/*) S=1 ;; *) [ -d "$1" ] && ! grep -qF "Spec.make("$1"" "$R/packages/cli/src/commands/commands.ts" 2>/dev/null && S=1 ;; esac; [ -z "$S" ] || bun "$E" service stop >/dev/null 2>&1; exec bun "$E"
